submission.reasoning: On workstation5, user WORKSTATION5\wardog ran bitsadmin.exe (proc-826bdb1e01) at high integrity from an interactive cmd.exe (proc-29da349e7e). It created a foreground BITS /transfer job that pulled content from raw.githubusercontent.com (atomic-red-team T1197) and saved it as C:\Users\wardog\AppData\Local\Temp\bitsadmin1_flag.ps1. The graph also holds a DNS lookup for raw.githubusercontent.com (conn-96c2a572b6). This is BITS Jobs abuse (MITRE T1197) used to fetch a tool: a script lands in Temp under a .ps1 name. It matches the Atomic Red Team T1197 test, so it is a simulated attack, but it is still adversary behavior and should be handled as malicious. Next steps: isolate the host, rotate the wardog credentials, block the download endpoint, and delete or verify the downloaded file and any leftover BITS jobs.
